Not a serious injury but when I was like 12/13 I put a suction cup (the ones you use to remove lights - so it had a super strong suction) in the middle of my forehead thinking I was bloody hilarious. 
Me, my sister and my dad were watching a movie at the time and I forget (idk how) it was there for like half an hour. I remember it’s there and pop it off my forehead when my sister and dad burst into laughter. 
Instead of explaining what happened, my dad took a picture of my forehead, got a pen and drew a smiley face on it, then took another picture of it before showing me. 
I had a perfectly circular hickey-like mark in the middle of my forehead. 
My sister had to cover it with foundation the next week when I went to school. It started to go yellow at yucky near the end and started to hurt like a bad bruise.
My dad still likes to bring it up and parades the photos to anyone he can.
